description: Internal no-op flag used to exercise the feature-flag system. Not connected to any feature.
Pending room invitations, accept/decline actions, deep-link handling, and invite notifications.
Render enhanced Matrix message content including code, tables, pills, math, and jumbo emoji.
Use the compact mobile-first room header, composer, and chat navigation.
Focus mode / Do Not Disturb: suppress notifications for a preset duration or indefinitely, from Settings or the tray menu.
Show an unfurled title/description/thumbnail card under messages containing a URL.
Manage room aliases and the canonical alias from room settings.
Filter Home, direct-message, and space room lists to rooms needing attention.
Add the next set of message actions, beginning with copying a canonical message permalink.
Improve attachment sending with a visible file drag-and-drop target and later media-send controls.
Show a compact last-message preview with sender label under each room-list row.
Pin/unpin and reorder the space rail, and manage a space from its right-click context menu (Invite, Add Existing, Mark/Unmark Suggested, Remove, Leave).
Create and reorganize nested spaces, and open their space-management settings.
Pin/unpin messages in a room, browse the pinned-messages panel, and show the room-header pin-count badge.
Privacy controls for read receipts, typing indicators, presence (appear offline), and auto-idle timeout, plus expanded seen-by and presence status display.
Bookmark a message from its action menu and browse saved messages from a global Settings panel.
Switch Home, direct-message, and space room lists between default, alphabetical, unread-first, and activity ordering.
Show a typing badge on room-list rows for rooms with someone currently typing.
Open profile cards for visible Matrix users, including room-specific identity, presence, and mutual rooms.
Render membership and room-state changes in the timeline.
Use multi-stage Matrix registration, password recovery, provider-aware SSO, and token login.
Build and query an encrypted device-local index of decrypted Matrix messages.
Jump to joined rooms, direct messages, and spaces with a fuzzy keyboard launcher.
Use the searchable full-Unicode emoji picker for reactions and composer insertion.
Show composite group-DM avatars and richer avatar/presence indicators in room and member lists.
Open a calendar from the room header and jump to the first event on that date.
Upgrade rooms to the homeserver's recommended version and guide members to the replacement room.
Record, preview, and send voice messages from the composer.
